OUR APPROACH

Every asset, three ways covered

The FortiMarkTT framework built into every job we do.

Protect

A permanent, visible tag that signals your assets are identified and harder to move without questions.

Identify

Custom serials, barcodes, or QR codes tagged directly onto each asset for fast, unmistakable identification.

Trace

Each tag links back to a record you control — clear, permanent proof of ownership whenever you need it.

SERVICES

Three ways to tag it as yours

Every job is performed on your equipment, at your location, using precision marking equipment built for field work.

01 / TAG

Laser Engraving

Deep, permanent identification marked directly into metal, coated surfaces, plastics, or glass — company name, ID number, or custom text that won't wear off or peel away.

02 / TAG

Barcode Tagging

Scannable barcodes marked onto tools, equipment, and fixed assets, giving you a fast, consistent way to identify inventory without a stick-on label to lose.

03 / TAG

QR Code Tagging

QR codes marked straight into the asset surface, ready to link to ownership details, service records, or your own inventory system.

HOW IT WORKS

Four steps, one visit

01

Book a visit

Reach out with your location and how many assets need tagging. We schedule around your operation, not the other way around.

02

We arrive on-site

Our technician brings the full mobile rig — no assets leave your premises, and nothing sits in a shop queue.

03

Tag & verify

Each item is marked to spec and checked for legibility and durability before we move to the next.

04

Asset tagged

You're left with a permanent identifier that survives weather, handling, and time — and a much harder target for theft.

WHY IT WORKS

Tagged assets are less attractive to steal — and easier to recover a claim on if they are

A visible, permanent tag changes the calculation for anyone eyeing your equipment. It signals the item is identifiable, tracked in someone's records, and harder to resell without questions.

  • Marked directly into the material — can't be peeled, soaked off, or swapped like a sticker
  • Visible deterrent that flags an asset as identified before it's ever taken
  • Clear, permanent proof of ownership for insurance and internal records
  • Consistent tagging across your whole inventory, done in one on-site visit
